svg.title: The six building blocks of neat-os
svg.desc: Five building blocks on a spectrum from judgement to deterministic code: Principle, one judgement rule; Convention, a locked fact, same in every repo; Playbook, ordered steps with a stop point; Skill, one capability, run on demand; Script, deterministic code owns green, and is preferred: anything software can prevent becomes a script. The coding agent sits above the spectrum and follows all five. Not building blocks: project knowledge lives in the product repo; decisions live as ADRs. A sixth kind, reviewer agents, is planned.
